An.bar_b_note: The Tidewake beach palette (cyan water, pale dunes) carries it, but flat noon light, no haze or sky drama, and an over-shoulder camera where the player's back outweighs the speaker (Bex and Irva frames) keep it below Palworld finish.

Tq.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra model matches the owner style bar (white fleece, dark horns, blue accents, clearly larger than the trainer); side B is let down by a hit react that looks the same as standing and faint poses that twist and seem to hover.

Yv.bar_b_note: The purple storm sky, rain and glowing mushrooms carry the Stormwood mood, but the Captain Marrow frame shows only the tiny player under a flat brown overhang with no speaker, and the forest floor is a uniform dark carpet.

Uw.bar_b_note: The plated boar has a strong, large silhouette, but the hit react looks the same as standing, faint mid floats above its own shadow, faint end collapses into a black, misshapen mass, and B's all-dark-brown material loses value separation (A's orange-red glow adds interest but the tusks pick up a reddish tint).

Kr.bar_b_note: Both Captain Marrow frames are half filled by a flat brown overhead slab with no speaker in view, only the small distant player; the Officer Nysa close-up reads well but crops the player's head at the left edge.

Sz.bar_b_note: Old Bram on the warm meadow with cool blue distance is close to the key art, but the stronghold interiors (Solene, Hald) sink into one orange mid-tone, a little hotter on side B, with no light shafts or depth.

Ul.bar_b_note: Kelm and Captain Veyra are clearly framed with a striking winged lion behind them, but the courtyard is a flat, evenly tiled brown dirt plane under plain daylight with no Cloudreach sky depth or stratified stone at scale.

Wp.bar_b_note: Captain Nerissa reads in both chamber frames, but the Resident Nalia frame is a bare grey-green slope with one small figure and no identifiable speaker, and the chambers are murky and underlit with no Tidewake cyan.

Zi.bar_b_note: An appealing, well-finished elder villager with clear eyes, a readable silhouette and a natural green-brown palette that fits the key art; B's skin is slightly more flushed.

Wi.bar_b_note: A dark, low-value forest in which the spider boss is the only readable subject, the player's creature is barely visible, flat magenta rings and slabs act as telegraphs (A i06-i10, i15-i17, tell2 a-c; B i09-i10, i16-i17), and in B the camera sits inside trunks and foliage for i12-i15.

top_changes.change: Dialogue camera rule: frame the named speaker at medium-close range beside the panel, run a line-of-sight check that removes overhead slabs and trunks (Kr Marrow frames, Yv Marrow, Wp Nalia), and shrink the player's over-shoulder footprint.

Replace flat magenta telegraph rings and slabs with real-object ground effects (cracks, debris, lightning strikes), add camera collision against Stormwood trunks and foliage, and lift fight lighting so the player's creature separates from the ground (Wi).
Fix creature reaction and faint poses: a distinct hit react, grounded faint mid and end with no floating or deformed collapse (Uw faint end, Tq side B faint poses).
